[[Mutation]] (+20% Rewards) |rewards = {{RewardsList|Insane|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide|Modifiers = 1.3}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|sunny day over the Gilded Path|Your_Adversary on X|https://x.com/Your_Adv/status/1782048953061511275}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Gilded Path''' is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place near an old stone temple, filled with ruins. '''Gilded Path''' has two modifiers, these being [[All Paths]] that makes most enemies spawn on both sides and [[Mutation]], which increases the health of enemies every wave by 5%. Both of these modifiers boost the rewards given by 30%. ==Design & Path== '''Gilded Path''' takes place on a a flat area, surrounded by mountains on three sides and by an ocean on one side. The map is in a small birch forest inhabited by various golden creatures of various bodies and sizes. A few small grey and gold rocks are also scattered around the map. A dead corpse of the [[Gold Titan]] can also be seen in near a few flowers. The path starts at a red portal and ends at a blue portal. It has two separate paths, which intersect near the middle of the map and combine into one path near the end. ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:Gilded PathV2}} |Version 1 |{{Map:Gilded Path}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Insane|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide|Modifiers = 1.3}} ==Strategy== *It is recommended to place your towers near the intersection. **These spots are especially useful for towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Shotgunner]] and [[Assassin]], as their pierce allows them to kill enemies from both paths. **Do note that you cannot place ground towers on certain parts of the map, which limits your placement. It is recommended to put your towers near the second intersection as it offers more space. *There are multiple cliff spots on this map. However, they are spread out across the entire map, making them harder to use. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Enforcer Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|Current version on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} 9MapsDI.png|First version on a development image. GildedPathDI1.jpg|Current version on a development image. GildedPathDI2.jpg|Current version on a development image. GildedPathDI3.jpg|Current version on a development image. GildedPathDI4.jpg|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *Multiple golden creatures can be seen around the map, which are a reference to the now [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. **The entities shown in the map do not resemble any of the enemies present in that mode in the most recent version of the map except for one which is the corpse of the [[Gold Titan]]. **The original version of the map had multiple corpses of [[Golden]]s and one corpse of the [[Gold Titan]]. A rusted humanoid that looked similar to the [[Rusted]] could also be seen near the back of the temple. ***Due to the map creator not having access to the original [[Gold Titan]] model, the model used has a 4-pack which was not present on the enemy. *The current version of the map was supposed to have a football on it that players could move aroundhttps://x.com/Your_Adv/status/1782048985093419196, though this does not appear to have been added into the main game. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Gilded Path''' added. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Insane}} to {{Color|Hard}}. *'''20 August 2025''' - [[v1.73.0]] **'''Gilded Path''' remade. ***Previous version has been kept in-game as [[Legacy Gilded Path]]. **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Hard}} to {{Color|Insane}}. **[[All Paths]] added. **[[Mutation]] added. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}}
